evidenceBoundary: This is an automated local packaging rehearsal using a fictional declarative fixture. It is not a human onboarding study, customer evidence, real-system acceptance, production readiness, or an under-one-day result.

participantCommands: generic acceptance executor: run fixed ten-case campaign
generic acceptance executor: reload completed campaign from durable state

explicitFixtureConfirmations: bounded workflow and exact requested operations
read and write authority, limits, forbidden actions, and retry policy
observable completion, duplicate, collateral-effect, and freshness rules
independence of the fictional observation binding
disposable fixture reset and durable-state requirements

customerSpecificWork.explicitProxy: The fixture uses declarative binding and case files as a measurable proxy. A real onboarding still needs executable customer-local action and observation bindings; this rehearsal does not count those declarations as working customer code.

authorOnlyStepDisposition.step: Describe the bounded workflow, exact operations, and business outcome.
authorOnlyStepDisposition.detail: Captured in intake.json with explicit customerConfirmed fields; the factory does not infer consequential scope.

authorOnlyStepDisposition.step: Extract operations, credentials, request shapes, and retry risks from approved API material.
authorOnlyStepDisposition.detail: The durable preparation CLI generated a provenance-bound proposal from the local OpenAPI document.

authorOnlyStepDisposition.step: Specify permissions, limits, approval, and retry rules.
authorOnlyStepDisposition.detail: Captured as explicit authority-wizard answers and compiled fail-closed.

authorOnlyStepDisposition.step: Calculate and copy proposal, verifier, authority, and binding digests into review input.
authorOnlyStepDisposition.detail: The teardown runner derived and wrote the exact review artifact; stale or mutated artifacts remain rejected by the workflow.

authorOnlyStepDisposition.step: Implement the customer-local action runtime binding.
authorOnlyStepDisposition.detail: The current factory records and digest-binds a declaration but does not generate or prove the executable action binding.

authorOnlyStepDisposition.step: Implement the independently authenticated outcome observer binding.
authorOnlyStepDisposition.detail: The current factory proposes the verifier contract but does not generate and qualify the customer-specific observation adapter.

authorOnlyStepDisposition.step: Execute and resume the fixed ten-case acceptance campaign.
authorOnlyStepDisposition.detail: The generic executor preserved case order, receipts, safety accounting, durable reload, and no-repeat behavior.

authorOnlyStepDisposition.step: Measure real engineer onboarding time and comprehension.
authorOnlyStepDisposition.detail: No fresh human participated; machine runtime cannot be reported as engineer active time or under-one-day evidence.

preciseRemainingBlockers.requiredWork: Generate or implement the exact customer-local operation binding, then independently review and digest-bind it before execution.
Generate or implement the separately authenticated observation adapter and pass negative-control qualification before it can verify outcomes.
Provide customer-local credential aliases, disposable access, and an activation decision; preparation itself grants no authority.
A genuinely fresh platform engineer must use the frozen package while active time, questions, edits, and author interventions are observed.

conclusion: The clean package reached acceptance-scaffold-ready and completed the fictional ten-case packaging rehearsal with durable reload and zero surviving incorrect effects. The core usability gap is no longer command orchestration; it is producing and qualifying the two executable customer-specific bindings without author knowledge.
